_comment: PUBLIC PROOF METRICS REGISTRY — Canonical source of truth for ALL customer-facing proof numbers. Consumers: (1) hero proof strip, (2) proof dock, (3) session trust panel, (4) Schema.org structured data, (5) simulator defaults, (6) case study averages. The metrics loader in index.html fetches this file and propagates values to every data-metric element. Do NOT hardcode proof numbers in HTML or JS. To update: change values here, loader handles the rest. NOTE: Schema.org aggregateRating in index.html (line ~53) must be updated manually when avg_rating or reviews_count changes — crawlers do not execute JS.
